title: Design System: Stage Point Master Investor Site

title.purpose: Card headings, note-term labels, team member names.

label.purpose: Eyebrow tags, nav links, stat captions; uppercase, letter-spaced.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default state for all cards; separation comes from the 1px border, not shadow.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards only, paired with a 2-4px upward translate on hover.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for scroll-triggered entrances (fade + upward translate).

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Card hover elevation and button state changes.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Card hover elevation, nav state changes.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section reveals; stays under the 300ms UI-transition ceiling.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button (Request the Offering Memorandum, Speak with the Team).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #002060; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #001233; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #66A7B8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside the primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #002060; padding: 12.5px 30px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid #002060; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EEF2F9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #66A7B8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Marquee track-record statistic with count-up numeral.
components.html: 50thConsecutive Quarter of Positive Returns
components.css: .ds-card-stat { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; transition: box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1); } .ds-card-stat:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 32, 96, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-stat-value { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.5rem; color: #002060; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-stat-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748B; }

components.name: Note Term Card
components.css: .ds-card-term { background: #F8FAFC; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 32px; text-align: center; transition: box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1), border-color 240ms; } .ds-card-term:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 32, 96, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #66A7B8; } .ds-card-term-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-term-value { display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2.75rem; color: #002060; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-term-sub { display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #334155; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky top navigation with wordmark, anchor links, and primary CTA.
components.html:
Stage Point Master
OfferingTrack RecordProtectionTeam
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 32px; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0; } .ds-nav-wordmark { font-family: Source Serif 4, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #002060; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #334155; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: #002060; border-color: #66A7B8; }

narrative.overview: This system treats the web page the way Stage Point treats a loan: conservatively underwritten, fully collateralized by evidence, and free of unnecessary risk. The aesthetic is the calm confidence of a well-prepared institutional document, not the energy of a startup pitch. Deep navy and muted steel-teal read as bank-grade rather than fintech-trendy; generous whitespace and a serif display face borrow the gravitas of print finance while the interface itself stays modern, fast, and legible on a phone. The system explicitly rejects the crypto/fintech hype register and the generic SaaS-startup register. Nothing on the page should feel like it was assembled from a landing-page template.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy dominant (60-70% of visual weight), steel-teal reserved for accents and the single most important element per section.
Serif display headlines paired with a clean grotesque sans for body copy and UI chrome.
Flat, bordered surfaces over heavy shadows; depth from tonal layering and hairline borders.
Numbers render large and unadorned; the statistic is the persuasion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Steel teal never exceeds roughly 10% of any given section's visual weight. It marks the single most important number or interactive element on screen, never a background or a decorative flourish.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Flat color fields only. No gradients, no glassmorphism, no neon glows. Depth comes from tonal layering and hairline borders, never from blur or transparency effects.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Weight Rule
rules.body: Serif type appears only at Display and Headline sizes, where its gravitas reads clearly. Anything smaller stays in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and bordered at rest. Shadow is a response to interaction, never a resting state.

dos: Do keep steel-teal (#66A7B8) under roughly 10% of any section's visual weight.
Do use flat, bordered surfaces (1px #E2E8F0) as the default container style; reserve shadow for hover states only.
Do set all body copy in Inter at Neutral Slate (#334155) or Neutral Ink (#1A1A1A), never pure black on pure white for large text blocks.
Do reserve the serif (Source Serif 4) for Display and Headline sizes only.
Do let statistics render large and unadorned.
donts: Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, neon glows, or any crypto/fintech hype visual language.
Don't use bouncy illustrations, purple gradient blobs, or Get-Started-Free urgency patterns borrowed from generic SaaS landing pages.
Don't use em dashes as sentence punctuation, exclamation marks, all-caps sentences, or emojis anywhere on the page.
Don't use border-left or edge stripes as a decorative accent on cards.
Don't scale elements from zero on entrance, animate box-shadow or non-GPU properties, or run any UI transition longer than 300ms.
Don't let any animation ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
